# Error codes

Every failure is a `DarkroomError` with a stable code, a plain message and a next step. Tool results and the CLI show `[CODE] message` and `Next step: ...`. The messages below are the defaults; a call may add detail. There is no licence logic: Adobe-related messages say *likely* and point to the Adobe app.

| Code | Default message | Default next step |
|---|---|---|
| `ADOBE_FEATURE_UNAVAILABLE` | The Adobe app reports that a required feature is disabled. | This is likely a license or trial issue inside the Adobe app. Fix it in the Adobe app, then retry. |
| `ADOBE_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED` | The detected Adobe app version has not been tested with darkroom_ai. | Compare the detected version with the tested versions in the README and use a tested version. |
| `CONFIG_INVALID` | The configuration is not valid. | Fix the listed settings in darkroom.toml (or darkroom.local.toml) and run `darkroom doctor`. |
| `CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED` | This action needs your explicit go-ahead. | Review the plan that was shown and confirm it to continue. |
| `CONNECTOR_STALE` | The darkroom_ai connector is running older code than the files on disk, so it refuses to change anything. | Restart the connector: toggle darkroom_ai off and on in Hermes' Capabilities (or quit and reopen Hermes), or run `darkroom connectors --stop-stale`. Reads still work. |
| `FACE_MODEL_MISSING` | No face-detection model is available, so face and skin-tone analysis is switched off. | Put a YuNet face-detection ONNX file on this computer and set its path as faces.model in darkroom.toml. Nothing is downloaded automatically. |
| `GUARDRAIL_REJECTED` | The request is outside a safety rule. | Read the message above; nothing was changed. |
| `IMAGE_UNREADABLE` | The image file could not be read. | Check that the file exists and is a JPG, PNG, TIFF or supported RAW file. |
| `LLM_BAD_TOOL_CALL` | The model returned a tool call that could not be used. | Retry; if it keeps happening, change tool_mode for this profile or try another profile (`darkroom models test` compares them). |
| `LLM_MODEL_NOT_LOADED` | The model of the active profile is not loaded in the local model server. | Load the model in the local model server (for example in LM Studio), then retry. darkroom_ai does not ask the server to load models by itself; to allow that, set require_loaded = false under [llm] in darkroom.toml. |
| `LLM_NOT_REACHABLE` | The local model server did not answer. | Start the local model server (for example LM Studio's local server), load the model named in the active profile, and check base_url in darkroom.toml. |
| `LLM_NO_VISION` | The active model did not accept an image. | Load a model with its vision projector (mmproj) or switch to a profile with vision = true that passes `darkroom models test`. |
| `LLM_REQUEST_FAILED` | The local model server answered with an error. | Read the message above. Check that the model named in the profile is downloaded and can be loaded in the local model server, then retry. |
| `LR_BUSY_USER` | Lightroom is being used by the person, so darkroom_ai could not take over its Develop view. | Ask the person to stop clicking in Lightroom and leave it on any screen, then call the same tool again. darkroom_ai only takes over once Lightroom has been still for a few seconds. |
| `LR_COMMAND_FAILED` | Lightroom could not carry out the command. | Read the message above; if it mentions the token, run `darkroom lightroom setup` and reload the plug-in in the Plug-in Manager. |
| `LR_NOT_REACHABLE` | Lightroom Classic did not answer on its local plugin connection. | Check that Lightroom Classic is open, the darkroom plugin is enabled in the Plug-in Manager, its connection is started (File > Plug-in Extras > "Start darkroom_ai Bridge"), and no dialog is waiting (likely candidates: sign-in, trial or license prompts). Then retry. |
| `LR_WRONG_CATALOG` | Lightroom has a different catalog open than the one darkroom_ai is configured for. | Open the configured catalog in Lightroom, or change lightroom.test_catalog and run `darkroom lightroom setup` again. Nothing was changed. |
| `MASK_FAILED` | The subject mask could not be created. | Read the message above; try another mask backend (masks.backend in darkroom.toml) or another photo. |
| `MASK_MODEL_MISSING` | The local mask model is not available. | Install the ml extra (`make install-ml`) and set the path of your own ONNX model file in darkroom.toml. Nothing is downloaded automatically. |
| `NON_LOCAL_ENDPOINT` | A configured address is not a local (loopback) address. | darkroom_ai only talks to this computer. Use 127.0.0.1, localhost or ::1. |
| `PS_COMMAND_FAILED` | Photoshop could not carry out the command. | Read the message above, check the document in Photoshop, then retry. |
| `PS_NOT_REACHABLE` | Photoshop did not answer in time or could not be started. | Check that Photoshop is running and no dialog is waiting (likely candidates: sign-in, trial or license prompts, or an open modal dialog). Then retry. |
